node.title: Re^2: Add optional modules to TEST_REQUIRES?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Test2::Plugin::BailOnFail, Sub::Override

I know this goes against the grain of this thread, and I'm glad you got it working, but: [mod://Test2::Plugin::BailOnFail] is basically just [https://metacpan.org/source/EXODIST/Test2-Suite-0.000127/lib/Test2/Plugin/BailOnFail.pm#L13|five lines of code], and [mod://Sub::Override] is a more sophisticated version of local *subname = sub { print "overridden" };. As I [id://11108987|said], personally, in a case like this I wouldn't depend on those modules at all.
